slides.executiveSummary: Cove Island ferry ridership has grown every year since 2021, the 11:40 sailing turned away 9,800 riders in 2025, and a fourth daily sailing at about $1.1M a year would carry them.

slides.slideTitle: Add a midday sailing to the Cove Island ferry
slides.subtitle: A request to the finance committee
slides.speakerNotes: Good morning. I'm asking the committee for one thing today: a fourth daily sailing on the Cove Island ferry, starting next year. Everything that follows is why.

slides.slideTitle: Ridership has grown every year since 2021
slides.speakerNotes: Start with demand. Ridership has risen every single year since 2021, from 412,000 to 604,000 riders, and it has not levelled off.

slides.slideTitle: 9,800 riders were turned away at midday in 2025
keyBullets: riders turned away from the full 11:40 sailing in 2025
slides.speakerNotes: Here is what that growth costs us. In 2025 the 11:40 sailing filled up and we turned 9,800 people away at the dock: riders who wanted to pay us and could not board.

slides.slideTitle: Turnaways have five-folded in four years
slides.speakerNotes: And it is getting worse fast. Turnaways went from 1,900 in 2021 to 9,800 last year, five times as many in four years, and the midday is where it happens.

slides.slideTitle: A fourth sailing at 1:10 carries the riders we turn away
keyBullets: Runs 1:10 pm daily, between the full 11:40 and the 3:30
Uses the spare boat already in the fleet
Costs about $1.1M a year to run
slides.speakerNotes: The fix is a fourth sailing at 1:10, between the full 11:40 and the 3:30. It uses the spare boat already in the fleet, so there is no capital ask, only about $1.1M a year to run it.

keyBullets: Approve $1.1M a year for a fourth daily sailing
slides.speakerNotes: So the ask is simple: approve about $1.1M a year for a fourth daily sailing from 2026, and we will come back in twelve months with the ridership to show you what it did.

topic: A midday sailing for the Cove Island ferry
audience: The Bay Transit Authority board's finance committee

outline.bigIdea: A fourth daily sailing, at about $1.1M a year, carries the riders the ferry now turns away.
